data.body: Gerrit 1576 patch set 2 failed 10 deterministic default-suite tests across all four matrix lanes. RED evidence reproduced locally. Six failures were obsolete tests for the removed applier pass-record producer; deleted those suites while retaining current last-pass CAS/failure coverage. Fixed the real dry-run regression by keeping advisory-lock lifecycle but bypassing last-pass publication for dry-run. Fixed held-out CAS test isolation by patching a module-local sleep seam instead of process-global time.sleep. Refreshed the shrink-only complexity baseline. Validation: 90 focused tests and 576 broad compatibility tests pass; lint, mypy, env/CLI/ADR generators, ADR numbering, removal sweeps, and module-size pass. Fetched origin/main, rebased onto 69169fee210, and confirmed HEAD..origin/main=0 before patch set 3.
